boundaryControl.description: A valid UPDATE after the second state with event_data '1' and payload_public '23'; the refusal 'boundarySubstitution' re-splits these bytes.

refusals.name: genesisNotIssue
refusals.description: An UPDATE standing alone as a genesis.
refusals.error: genesis op must be ISSUE, got UPDATE

refusals.name: genesisWithPredecessor
refusals.description: An ISSUE carrying a previous_outpoint.
refusals.error: genesis previous_outpoint must be empty

refusals.name: genesisWithLineage
refusals.description: An ISSUE carrying a lineage_genesis.
refusals.error: genesis lineage_genesis must be empty

refusals.name: issueAfterGenesis
refusals.description: A second ISSUE spending the genesis.
refusals.error: ISSUE is allowed at genesis only

refusals.name: previousOutpointWrongIndex
refusals.description: After the TRANSFER whose DPP output sits at index 1, a state naming index 0 while spending index 1.
refusals.error: previous_outpoint must name the spent tip output

refusals.name: previousOutpointWrongTxid
refusals.description: A state naming the genesis as its predecessor while spending the second state.
refusals.error: previous_outpoint must name the spent tip

refusals.name: previousOutpointEmpty
refusals.description: A non-genesis state with an empty previous_outpoint.
refusals.error: non-genesis previous_outpoint must be set

refusals.name: lineageGenesisWrong
refusals.description: A state naming the second state, not the genesis, as its lineage.
refusals.error: lineage_genesis must name the chain genesis

refusals.name: passportIdChanged
refusals.description: A state under another passport identifier.
refusals.error: passport_id is immutable across the chain

refusals.name: controllerChangedOnUpdate
refusals.description: An UPDATE that moves the controller key.
refusals.error: controller_key changes only on TRANSFER

refusals.name: payloadChangedOnRetire
refusals.description: A RETIRE that changes payload_public.
refusals.error: payload_public / payload_owner_hash do not change on RETIRE

refusals.name: updateAfterRetire
refusals.description: An UPDATE by the controller spending the RETIRE.
refusals.error: the lineage is retired: no state may follow RETIRE

refusals.name: transferAfterRetire
refusals.description: A TRANSFER by the controller spending the RETIRE.
refusals.error: the lineage is retired: no state may follow RETIRE

refusals.name: controlNotProven
refusals.description: An UPDATE by a stranger with an empty control_linkage.
refusals.error: the actor is not the controller and control_linkage is empty

refusals.name: controlWrongLinkage
refusals.description: An UPDATE by a stranger carrying the stranger's own scalar, which links to nothing on this passport.
refusals.error: control_linkage does not link actor_identity_key to the previous controller_key

refusals.name: controlRedundantLinkage
refusals.description: An UPDATE by the controller key itself (equality) that also carries a scalar: one value, one spelling.
refusals.error: control_linkage must be empty when the actor is the controller or a named authority

refusals.name: recoveryWithoutAuthority
refusals.description: An UPDATE by the authority key with no control proof: refused unless the profile names it.
refusals.error: the actor is not the controller and control_linkage is empty

refusals.name: downgradeToVersion1
refusals.description: A version 1 SOLD spending a version 2 state.
refusals.error: a version 1 state cannot follow a version 2 state

refusals.name: actorSignatureFromVersion1Preimage
refusals.description: An UPDATE whose signatures were made over the unframed version 1 preimage under the version 1 protocol: a cross-version replay.
refusals.error: user_signature invalid

refusals.name: publisherSignatureInActorSlot
refusals.description: An UPDATE with the actor and publisher signatures exchanged: a cross-purpose replay.
refusals.error: user_signature invalid

refusals.name: boundarySubstitution
refusals.description: The state 'boundaryControl' with event_data '1' and payload_public '23' re-split as '12' and '3', both valid JSON, carrying the original's signatures. Under version 1 the two shared a preimage; under version 2 they do not.
refusals.error: user_signature invalid

refusals.name: transferWithoutCommitment
refusals.description: A TRANSFER with an empty authorisation_commitment: valid under the record model, refused under the managed-custody profile.
refusals.error: TRANSFER carries no authorisation_commitment under the managed-custody profile

upgrade.description: The version 1 fixture chain's sixth state spent by a version 2 UPDATE from the first owner, who holds its controller key: the lineage keeps its identifier, its genesis and its history, and continues under version 2.

refusals.name: upgradeNotUpdate
refusals.description: A version 2 TRANSFER spending the version 1 tip: the upgrade is an UPDATE.
refusals.error: a version 1 state is followed only by a version 2 UPDATE, the upgrade transition

refusals.name: upgradeChangesController
refusals.description: A version 2 UPDATE spending the version 1 tip with another controller key.
refusals.error: the upgrade transition keeps the controller key

refusals.name: upgradeWithoutLineage
refusals.description: A version 2 UPDATE spending the version 1 tip that names no lineage genesis.
refusals.error: lineage_genesis must name the chain genesis
